description.value: A BC Parks campground fronting Norbury and Peckham's lakes with sandy beach areas, non-motorized boating, rainbow trout fishing, and a dramatic backdrop of The Steeples in the Hughes Range; gate closes outside the operating season.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms this is an active provincial campground with 46 sites operated by EK Parks Ltd., with tent and caravan camping. The website prominently features a 'Book camping' link, confirming reservations are accepted via the BC Parks reservation system. The OSM operator phone (+1-250-422-3003 for EK Parks) does not appear in the fetched website content, which only lists general BC Parks contact numbers, so phone confirmation is null; the website URL matches OSM exactly.
concerns: OSM phone (+1-250-422-3003) is listed for operator EK Parks Ltd. but this number does not appear in the fetched BC Parks website content, which only provides general BC Parks contact numbers (1-800-689-9025); the operator number could not be confirmed or denied.
E-bikes are explicitly prohibited on all trails and restricted to park roads only — a meaningful limitation for e-bike touring cyclists that should be surfaced in any listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active 46-site provincial campground near Cranbrook with confirmed tent camping and reservations, well-suited for touring cyclists on the Hwy 3/93 corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: The park is located 18 km north of Hwy 3 and 16 km south of Hwy 93/95 near Cranbrook per the website, but no civic street address is available in OSM or on the website.
